content.text: Skip to main contentSkip to navigation News Oscars 2026: Full list of winners By Orlando Parfitt15 March 2026 No comments Save article Please Sign in to your account to use this feature Source: Trae Patton / The Academy ©A.M.P.A.S.Michael B. Jordan Best picture winner One Battle After Another, Michael B. Jordan and Jessie Buckley were among the winners at the 98th Academy Awards. The ceremony took place at the Dolby Theatre in Hollywood tonight (March 15), with Conan O’Brien hosting the ceremony for the second time. Other winners included Amy Madigan, Sean Penn, Sentimental Value for international feature film, and best animated film KPop Demon Hunters.
